data.one_liner: A Flutter package for inspecting widgets, colors, and sizes during debugging and QA testing.
data.what_it_does: Inspector provides a widget inspection overlay for Flutter apps, letting developers and QA testers measure sizes, view padding, pick colors, zoom in with a magnifying glass, and inspect typography or border radius. It includes keyboard shortcuts and can be customized with a custom UI via InspectorController.
use_when: You need to quickly inspect widget sizes, padding, and styling during development or QA testing.
You want an eyedropper/color picker tool built right into your debug build.
You need custom inspector UI controls built on top of an inspector controller.
avoid_when: In final production release builds, though it is disabled by default when kReleaseMode is true.
strengths: Includes helpful built-in tools like a color picker, size inspector, and magnifying glass.
Supports keyboard shortcuts for rapid toggling.
Exposes an InspectorController for building custom inspector UIs.
weaknesses: Package development is noted as still in progress (WIP) and things may break your app.
Absorbs pointer events when enabled to facilitate inspection.
data.setup_notes: Wrap MaterialApp.builder or WidgetsApp.builder with the Inspector widget.
data.minimal_example:
MaterialApp(
  home: ExampleApp(),
  builder: (context, child) => Inspector(child: child!),
)
